feedback.details: The sprint contract requires 5 distinct Container nodes matching PRD terminology: 'mobile app, web interface, QR scanner, photo capture, Hermes agent'. None of these appear as top-level container nodes. The diagram has: gardener (actor, line 6), telegram (external service, line 7), phomemo (external device, line 8), then inside subgraph sys: a nested subgraph 'frontend' (line 13) with internal components (ui, api_client, camera, qr_scanner, storage, hermes_client), plus backend (line 23), db (line 24), qr_service (line 25), printer_service (line 26). The 'Mobile App Frontend' (line 13) is a subgraph label, not a Container node. No one-sentence responsibility descriptions exist in any narrative (no narrative present).

Zero documentation of encryption. No mention of AES-256 or equivalent for data at rest. No TLS 1.2+ specification for data in transit. No prohibition on plaintext logging of PII/QR data/camera metadata. No reference to PRD security constraints (zero PRD citations anywhere in the file). Camera node (line 16) and qr_scanner node (line 17) handle sensitive input but have no security annotations.

Zero documentation of Hermes degradation or fallback. No fallback UI states defined. No data staleness tolerance (>24h flagged) mentioned. No user notification mechanism. No error boundaries specified. No retry backoff strategy (exponential, capped at 5 mins). No graceful degradation paths for any container. The Hermes Client node (line 19) has no narrative, no failure mode, no degradation path.

Zero documentation of offline queue and sync behavior. No local storage schema (IndexedDB/SQLite) is described in narrative — only 'Local Storage (IndexedDB, localStorage)' appears as a node label (line 18) with no capacity limits, no eviction policy, no conflict resolution strategy (LWW vs manual merge). No timeout thresholds specified. No sync backoff strategy documented. FR31-FR35 not referenced (zero FR matches in file).

markdownlint reports 2 errors: (1) MD013 at line 13: 89 characters (exceeds 80-char limit). (2) MD047: file does not end with a single newline character. Beyond linting: (a) No H1 heading exists — the frontmatter title (line 2) is YAML metadata, not a document heading. (b) No H2 sections — the file has no section structure. (c) Mermaid diagram is NOT in a fenced code block with language tag — grep confirms zero ``` fences. (d) No structured sections for container definitions, edge cases, or narrative.

The diagram text parses correctly via mmdc (exit 0) when extracted as raw Mermaid. However, (1) the diagram is NOT wrapped in a fenced code block — grep confirms zero ``` fence markers in the file. The sprint contract requires fenced code blocks tagged with 'mermaid'. (2) The node count is ~14 internal nodes (ui, api_client, camera, qr_scanner, storage, hermes_client, backend, db, qr_service, printer_service + external nodes), not the required 4-5 Container nodes. (3) The diagram is a component-level detail rather than a container-level view.

The file is 54 lines and contains ZERO narrative text beyond the YAML frontmatter (lines 1-3). grep for 'FR' and 'PRD' returns no matches. There is no structured mapping table linking containers to FR41-FR45 IDs and NFRs. There are zero PRD quotes or section references. Every structural requirement of the narrative section is absent.

Zero performance specifications. No maximum render time (<200ms initial paint, <50ms interaction) stated. No memory allocation limits. No garbage collection considerations for long-running queues. No mitigation strategy for any container exceeding thresholds. The API client node (line 15) labeled 'React Hooks, SWR' has no performance SLA.

The file includes 'Printer Service' (line 26), 'Plant Database' (line 24), and 'QR Code Service' (line 25) as system containers — these are out-of-scope for Sprint 3's 'Frontend Container' focus. No PRD file (prd.md) was found in the repo to verify exact scope boundaries, but modeling internal components and backend services is a scope violation. Post-MVP items are not tagged as [Post-MVP].

Multiple edges lack exact protocol, payload format, and authentication method. Line 39: 'Reads/writes cached data via' — no protocol specified (incomplete phrase). Line 31: 'Captures photos via camera' — not a protocol. Line 33: 'Scans QR codes via camera' — no transport protocol. Line 30: 'Views/enters data via touch UI' — vague. Some edges do specify protocol (line 43: HTTPS/JSON, line 54: Bluetooth LE, line 50: HTTP/JSON) but the majority lack the required combination of protocol + payload format + authentication method.

overall_summary: This file is fundamentally incomplete as a Sprint 3 C2 Container deliverable. It consists of only 54 lines: a 3-line YAML frontmatter header followed by raw Mermaid diagram text without any fenced code block, and zero narrative text. The diagram is architecturally misaligned with C2 expectations — it models internal subgraph components (ui, api_client, camera, qr_scanner, storage, hermes_client) rather than top-level Container nodes and contains ~14 nodes instead of the required 4-5. All 5 required containers (mobile app, web interface, QR scanner, photo capture, Hermes agent) are absent as distinct container nodes matching PRD terminology. The file has zero narrative, zero PRD citations, zero mapping tables, and zero documentation of any edge case (offline sync, Hermes degradation, data privacy, performance). Relationship labels frequently lack protocol, payload format, and authentication specification. The file fails markdownlint (MD013 line-length, MD047 trailing newline) and has no H1/H2 heading structure. This file needs a complete rewrite to meet basic contract requirements."}
